_comment: Copy to remote_hosts.json (gitignored) and edit for your beamlines. Maps a data-root prefix to the analysis host that owns it, so data-dependent MIDAS tools run where the data lives. Longest matching data_roots prefix wins. Omit this file entirely to use the single-host env fallback (APEXA_ANALYSIS_HOST + APEXA_REMOTE_DATA_ROOTS). Any tool also accepts an explicit host= that overrides inference.
